symptom: The conservative opening-route-recovery sweep found a parent-preserving 5e-7 learning-rate run, but stage 01 remains unresolved: soda-creek 60s still has policy_win_rate 0.6667, and 300s high-pressure win rate remains 0.0 on all three maps.
root_cause: Lowering the learning rate prevents the repair objective from damaging parent fixed-window behavior, but it also makes the update too weak to change the known soda-creek seed 63402 opening failure surface. The opening route recovery signal is useful as a safe base setting, but it is not target-specific enough to force the action 5 lock to switch into the successful action 7 / action 3 recovery pattern.
fix: Do not enter stage 02 from the 5e-7 checkpoint. Use it only as a parent-preserving baseline for the next targeted stage 01 attempt, adding a seed 63402 opening objective or online action-distribution guard before rerunning fixed-window validation.
validation: Ran 5e-6, 2e-6, 1e-6 and 5e-7 learning-rate probes with the same 256 timestep opening-route-recovery setup. Only the 5e-7 probe passed strict 60/180/300 second parent no-regression with 0 blockers, but its 60s soda-creek win rate remained 0.6667 and 300s high-pressure win rates remained 0.0/0.0/0.0.
